changelog: - **A suggested frame no longer takes in another group's node.** Insert ▸ Suggest frames sized each frame by a node footprint wider than the drawn node, and checked for other groups' nodes only by their centres, so a frame could be drawn round another group's node, which a frame drag would then carry along; on the Coffee roastery Template, Area 1 took in Roasted bean stock. Frames are now sized by the node as drawn, a suggestion whose frame would take in a node outside it is left out, and a large group is split at the widest gap that leaves both parts big enough, so a single far-off node no longer stops a group being suggested.
